apps.label: Apps to silence
apps.description: Process or app names, separated by commas. While Do Not Disturb is on, their own sounds are muted; they get them back when it ends

respect_calls.label: Leave calls alone
respect_calls.description: An app that is using the microphone is in a call, so it keeps its sound. Its pings are heard during the call too

busy_after.label: Leave long playback alone
busy_after.description: Seconds after which an app that keeps playing (a video, a stage channel) gets its sound back. 0 turns this off
